notes.title: "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS" Strongest Strategy [Second Bullet]
notes.content:
How to become a leader in the fierce competition among the masses? Popular science on the gameplay of 'The Strategies of the Heroes', you can take a look.

[b]✧Klotski✧[/b]
The Klotski is divided into 12 levels, and each level you pass will be rewarded. In the Klotski, the cards used by players will not wear any skills, master skills, or equipment. Each level of dead or transformed cards will not be able to participate in the rest of the battle unless they are revived.

Before battles in levels 3, 6, 9, and 12, players will receive a free chance to resurrect cards that died in battles before resurrection.

The Huarong coins obtained in Klotski can be exchanged for exclusive skill fragments in the exchange mall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/b91583c7341168dbcad67db5b11fa4bf201f2969.png[/img]

[b]✧Skills System✧[/b]
The skill system is one of the major highlights of this game, which is different from other TCG card games. Not only does the player character have skills, but the hero cards in the player's hand can also be matched with various skills according to their needs, and can be freely combined.
Hero card skills can be divided into Normal, Rare, Legendary, and peerless based on their rarity. Depending on the triggering time, they can be divided into Entry, Passive, Death Language, and Turn. By wearing skills on suitable hero cards, the combat ability of the cards can be greatly improved. It should be noted that skills cannot be used on hero cards with the same talent skills. And just like hero cards, skills can also be upgraded. You can obtain the required skill fragments for upgrading through games such as shopping malls!

In addition to the ability to wear hero cards, players can also activate the main skill after the character reaches level 13. The main skill cannot be divided into three types: gain, control, and output. The main skill does not need to be upgraded, only needs to meet the corresponding level requirements to wear it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/0ad79a4e3bdfba69f2ed9fd3dbfc81f342efe0af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/52460d414680d90e56fc462bf3838344c16ea3bf.png[/img]

[b]✧Daily Tasks✧[/b]
In the Qunxiong Strategy Card, there are "small goals" that can be completed every day. After completing them, you can not only receive rewards but also increase your activity level. Depending on the progress of your activity level, you can receive coins and ingots!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/cfa9465b67a51f982affb6c4693544f3ea679081.png[/img]

notes.title: "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS" The strongest strategy [first bullet]
notes.content:
How to become a leader in the fierce competition among the masses? Popular science on the gameplay of 'The Strategies of the Heroes', you can take a look.

[b]✧Camp Introduction✧[/b]
In the game, it is mainly divided into four major factions, each with its own characteristics. Players can choose different factions to combine according to their needs
1. Wei Faction: The characteristic of Wei Faction is that it has various direct attack skills, and various generals can often make their opponents defeat the formation without losing on the scene by overlapping their skills.
2. Shu faction: The Shu faction is the one with the highest attack among the four major factions, with a high attack advantage and often unstoppable in one's own turn.
3. Wu Faction: Wu Faction is a powerful lineup with powerful spells, such as Thunder, Fire, and various skills that make Wu Faction extremely capable of clearing scenes. If there are levels that require cleaning up in order to win, it is recommended to try using Wu Faction, which will have good results.
4. Group Hero Camp: The group hero camp has its own recovery system and various recovery skills, ensuring the ability to stand on the scene. After all, only the living are the winners
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/a6f84978c9924e4ae2d51fe1fcf334e92f5385fe.png[/img]

[b]✧Battle gameplay✧[/b]
Duel competition is a small arena where players from all regions of the Three Kingdoms World experience unlimited combinations of card skills and fun in battles. The system will randomly match players, and each player will receive identical random cards and skills. Daily challenges can earn you a daily reward treasure chest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/1777191e5126a291c3d2caaab8ac2c9898ea52c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/d2e79c914b1475ed16179f389aeb7b3721486787.png[/img]

[b]✧Feisheng gameplay✧[/b]
After the card soars, it can transform. Each card can only transform once in each battle. The card consumed by the transformation will release the death skill, while the main card of the transformation will release the entry skill, and the attack health will be reduced to 1.2 times the initial level. At the same time, the transformation will clear all positive and negative states on the body, and will also be immune to some negative skills. The skill description says "How to deal with non transformed cards", which is invalid for transformed cards, Transforming will immediately restore 1 Tiger Talisman (which is a limited number of cards in the lower right corner of the battlefield), but if the Tiger Talisman is 2 points before the transformation, the transformation will not restore the Tiger Talisman. The key is that all cards, regardless of their quality or rarity, can transform as long as they rise to 7 stars and fly up. Any card on our battlefield (including summoners or sheep) can be used for transformation consumption.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/9ddacfb7c97eb3ed8b343b298e0835b53c80557e.png[/img]

[b]✧Dungeon gameplay✧[/b]
Dungeons are a very interesting gameplay. You can earn generous clearance rewards by completing the dungeon progress! There are currently three types of dungeons, namely ordinary dungeons, elite dungeons, and strategic dungeons. Each type has 20 chapters, and each chapter has six levels. After the character completes the novice guidance, they can start the challenge dungeon mode. Every 5 levels, a new chapter is unlocked. After completing each chapter instance, you can receive chapter rewards! Don't forget to collect it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/fd2e9a99360b50fb559c2bbfc3e4d1c295cd4c57.png[/img]

notes.title: The Most Complete FAQ Collection of "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS"
notes.content:
In order to provide the protagonists with a better experience, we will provide answers to some common questions here~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43992177/aeaf31b80f0bae9175e18a07d0fe52376e39b876.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]

 ---Game download related---
Q: What should I do if I am unable to enter the game after starting it?
A: Please check if the computer's memory space is full and meets the system configuration requirements of the store page; Or check if the computer settings are connected to the network.

Q: What should I do if the game installation fails? Game update failed, what should I do if I get stuck loading?
A: 1) Game installation failed. Please check:
① Is it the installation package corresponding to the Steam platform's launch? If not, please download the correct package for installation.
② Is there enough storage space? If there is not enough storage space, you can clean up the computer storage space and restart the computer to try reinstalling.
③ If there is an error parsing the package, you can delete the game package, restart the computer, and download the correct package again for installation.
2) Game update failed, stuck loading, please check:
① Please check if the network is functioning properly
② If you are still unable to log in under normal network conditions, you can click on the [url=https://s.team/chat/FRdXyPRZ]Community chat group seeks feedback from administrator[/url] for handling.

---Switching language related---
Q: What if I don't understand the current language and want to switch languages?
A: For the gaming experience of the protagonists, we have temporarily set up two languages: Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The protagonists can enter the game's main interface [avatar] - [language] to switch operations.


---District server and account related---
Q: What should I do when I log in and prompt that the current server registration is full?
A: In order to ensure your gaming experience, we will control the upper limit of the number of people in each server. If the server you choose indicates that it is full, please choose another recommended server to play. Register on a first come, first served basis, and join the "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS"!

Q: Can protagonists downloaded from different channels play together?
A: "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS" is currently only available on the Steam platform and can only be logged in through the Steam account. Accounts logged in through the Steam channel can play together.

Q: Can heroes from different district servers play across districts?
A: The lords of different district servers can play together in the ranking; However, for non cross regional gameplay, such as the Sky Ladder Race, commanders from different regional servers are temporarily unable to play together.

Q: Is the number of servers on the first day of Steam's launch fixed?
A: On the first day of going live without deleting files, we will dynamically adjust the server expansion plan based on the actual number of people registered. Heroes can choose suitable servers according to their own needs. However, it should be noted that there is a registration limit for a single server, and the registration quota is on a first come, first served basis. If the desired server is full, you can switch to another server for registration.


---Reward collection and redemption related---
Q: I participated in a game activity, how can I claim the CDK reward obtained from the activity? And where is the entrance for CDK collection?
A: After the game characters reach level 6 and are guided by beginners, the protagonists can enter the main interface of the game - 【 Avatar 】 - 【 Gift Pack Redemption 】 to receive relevant operations.


----Feedback on server startup issues and game bugs---
Q: What should be done if there are issues such as inability to log in and frequent disconnections when opening the game server?
A: If the above issues occur during the game server opening, please be patient and wait for the project team to be on standby at any time to ensure the stability and good experience of the game. You can follow the official announcement or in game email information of the Steam platform, and we will inform you promptly if such issues arise.

[hr][/hr]
If you have any other questions, please feel free to leave a message on the platform for feedback and consultation. Thank you for your attention and support to "群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS".
